articles.title: Crypto’s favorite $90 trillion trading product is coming to Wall Street, but big banks are taking it slow
articles.snippet: Regulated perpetual futures are officially landing in the U.S., but while agile trading firms and crypto exchanges race to capture massive retail demand, traditional Wall Street banks are holding back until liquidity, rules, and infrastructure mature.

articles.title: Digital asset trading platform Uphold cuts 17% of global headcount as crypto winter bites
articles.snippet: The crypto trading platform said the layoffs reflect a strategic shift toward its fast-growing enterprise business.

articles.title: Thailand's SEC alleges Bitkub concealed cyberattack that led to $50 million hack
articles.snippet: Bitkub was the victim of a cyberattack in May 2021, which led to hacks stealing 1.7 billion baht across 16 different digital assets.

articles.title: Securitize builds Wall Street credentials with SEC adviser license as tokenization expands
articles.snippet: The license broadens the BlackRock tokenization partner's offering as regulators weigh rules for onchain investment products.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin gives up early gains as stocks reverse lower
articles.snippet: CoinEx's Jeff Ko sees bitcoin staying range-bound near $65,000 while retreating oil, a 4.7% 10-year yield and a week of mega-cap earnings set the tone.
